name: Flarg
description: The home of the goblins studied by Armand.

description_citations.text: "The Colors of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Evidence suggests the goblins' cricket obsession spiraled into a civil war that wiped them out.
timeline.quote: leading to a civil war that wiped out the goblins, leaving only ruins.

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "Goblinology , by Francis Lebaron". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Flarg's goblins raid far south across the plains during the Dark Age.
timeline.quote: The Goblins of the Flarg were particularly active during the second era

timeline.summary: Tivadar of Thorn rallies the Church of Tal and, aided by Rasputin Dreamweaver, wages a crusade that decimates the goblin hordes.
timeline.quote: the goblin hordes had been decimated, retreating into their northern abodes

citation.text: "Flarg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A goblin cricket game escalates until the Raiders and Packers exterminate each other, ending the goblin threat.
timeline.quote: the Raiders and the Packers exterminated each other
